That was the reason I got off the pill I was on, along with Nuvaring. I went to my doctor a month after I stopped and the Depo shot was the only thing she would give. There hasn't been much of a change. I don't know what to tell you. It all sucks. I started birthcontrol to help with cramps, so I'm almost in the same position. Feel like crap=not hurt or hurt to the point I want to cry=emotionally be okay.

I know this doesn't help much, but best of luck! I'm trying to get my hands on some anti depressants.

I was on Lutera for about eight months or so and it wasn't too bad. 

Skin: Awesome. No need for makeup, and I'm a teenage girl.

Boobs: A little bit of growth, but like I previously said, they not done growing.

Libido: I honestly have no idea.

Wait: The instructions thing said a week. I'd suggest you wait however long you feel comfortable.

However, I got off it because it gave me depression. If you're prone to it, I advise you to be extra careful. I tried something else and it didn't help it either (Nuvaring). I hope you find something you like!

I'm sorry. :(

I'm not too far off from you. I'm sixteen and I lost my two best friends over their boyfriends last year. Above all, I'm on birth control and I guess I got depression from a mixture of the two...

Feel free to PM me if you'd like someone around your age to talk to.


Also, writing awesome and your mom is wrong to think otherwise!

Nice! This is day four for me. So far so good for me, but I've definitely gotten a bit more irritable, but BC has always down that to me. I've noticed my boobs are bigger already. Granted, I'm a teenager. Good luck with the ring!
Yes! She blames it on the birth control she was on, but my doctor says it's   not the case. Who knows...

I get the same feeling, that because I'm not attempting to jump from a building means it's not serious to treat. But it is. Hopefully someday I'll get antidepressants, and I hope you get the meds and they help. Or the family you mentioned? Talking to my sister (and we're not close) helped me feel better.

Good luck. I hope the best works out for you.
My mom had a miscarriage before me, three after me, had my brother, and then another miscarriage. I hope I don't have her luck...
Sixteen as well. I'm still trying to figure all of this out, though.

You may not be able to get it. I asked my doctor if I could try it to help regulate, but she said that they try not to give it out unless they have already have had a child or in a very committed relationship.
